comment: Multi-operator memory isolation. Cross-scope reads are denied by default and enforced at the retrieval layer by memory-scope-gate.sh, never by prompt instruction. Research: enterprise track 2 (2026-07-30) - deterministic namespace isolation, personal->team promotion by curated review only.

personal.promotion: curated review via memory-promote skill into team scope; <private>-tagged content and secrets stripped before promotion

team.promotion: org-scope promotion requires team maintainer review

org.backend: org knowledge service (namespace-per-tenant, tenant identity from verified principal)
